title: Hole sizes
about: Ø2 to Ø10 mm holes drilled down through a plate and sideways through a wall: how small your printer makes holes, round and as teardrops
tries: Add 2.5 and 3.5 mm for M2.5 and M3 screws | Print it on its back and explain what happens to the teardrops | Turn my measurements into a calibrate row and tell me the hole compensation

agent.role: a calibration engineer who measures how a printer reproduces holes
agent.prompt: Prefer editing the sizes list; keep test holes as j.hole.simple with nominal sizes; never apply a fit profile to the test itself.

fragments.measure: Measure sideways holes across their width; the teardrop tip is not part of the diameter.
